description: Frozen before live collection: five targeted fictional composition checks with different facts and wording. Not an independent general-reasoning benchmark.

memories.text: I completed the camera kickoff milestone on Monday, 17 August 2026.
I completed the thermal imaging prototype milestone on Thursday, 20 August 2026.
Noor is my telescope workshop partner.
I prefer workshop meetings between 10:00 and 12:00.
I prefer answers no longer than three sentences unless I ask for detail.
I changed my tea preference to hibiscus without sugar on Wednesday, 19 August 2026.
I plan to take the bus to Fujairah on Friday, 21 August 2026.
I plan to visit the maritime museum in Ajman on Sunday, 23 August 2026.

cases.prompt: Who is my telescope workshop partner?
cases.expected: Noor is your telescope workshop partner.

cases.prompt: Create a two-entry chronological timeline comparing when I changed my tea preference with when I completed the thermal imaging milestone, and explain which came later.
cases.expected: Hibiscus without sugar on Wednesday 19 August, thermal imaging completed Thursday 20 August; second entry later.

cases.prompt: Compare my earlier and most recent completed milestones, say which is newer, and name my collaborator.
cases.expected: Camera kickoff Monday 17 August, thermal imaging Thursday 20 August newer; Noor is your telescope workshop partner.

cases.prompt: Create a detailed three-stage preparation plan for presenting the completed thermal imaging prototype during my preferred workshop-meeting window, and explicitly note my answer-length preference.
cases.expected: Three preparation stages, completed thermal imaging prototype, meetings 10:00 to 12:00, answers no longer than three sentences unless detail requested.

cases.prompt: Compare my Friday and Sunday travel plans and build a preparation checklist that keeps both dates and destinations distinct.
cases.expected: Friday 21 August bus to Fujairah; Sunday 23 August maritime museum in Ajman; checklist for each date.
